name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
summary: Lets two companies share confidential information with each other for a stated purpose, such as evaluating a business relationship.
intro: This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (the “MNDA”) consists of: (1) this Cover Page (“Cover Page”) and (2) the Common Paper Mutual NDA Standard Terms Version 1.0 (“Standard Terms”) identical to those posted at commonpaper.com/standards/mutual-nda/1.0. Any modifications of the Standard Terms should be made on the Cover Page, which will control over conflicts with the Standard Terms.
signingStatement: By signing this Cover Page, each party agrees to enter into this MNDA as of the Effective Date.
attribution: Common Paper Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Version 1.0) free to use under CC BY 4.0.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.help: How Confidential Information may be used. The template suggests: Evaluating whether to enter into a business relationship with the other party.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.help: The date the MNDA starts.

fields.label: MNDA Term
fields.help: The length of this MNDA: either expires a whole number of years from the Effective Date, or continues until terminated in accordance with the terms of the MNDA.

fields.label: Term of Confidentiality
fields.help: How long Confidential Information is protected: a whole number of years from the Effective Date (trade secrets stay protected while they remain trade secrets), or in perpetuity.
fields.default: 1 year from Effective Date, but in the case of trade secrets until Confidential Information is no longer considered a trade secret under applicable laws.

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.help: Just the name of the US state whose laws govern the MNDA, e.g. Delaware (the Standard Terms say “the laws of the State of …”).

fields.label: Jurisdiction
fields.help: Just the city or county and state whose courts hear disputes, e.g. New Castle, DE (the Standard Terms say “courts located in …”).

fields.label: MNDA Modifications
fields.help: Any changes to the Standard Terms. Leave blank unless the user asks for a change.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
summary: For selling or buying cloud software (SaaS): access and use, fees, data, warranties, liability and termination.
attribution: Common Paper Cloud Service Agreement Standard Terms (Version 3.0) free to use under CC BY 4.0.

fields.label: Cloud Service
fields.help: The name and a short description of the cloud product being provided.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.help: The date the agreement's framework terms start.

fields.label: Order Date
fields.help: The date this Order Form starts. Usually the same as the Effective Date.

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.help: The length of each subscription term, e.g. 1 year. It renews automatically unless a party gives notice of non-renewal.

fields.label: Non-Renewal Notice Date
fields.help: The deadline for giving notice of non-renewal, e.g. 30 days before the end of the current Subscription Period.

fields.label: Fees
fields.help: The subscription fees and billing frequency, e.g. $12,000 per year, billed annually in advance.

fields.label: Technical Support
fields.help: The support Provider gives, e.g. email support on business days, 9am to 5pm Pacific.

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.help: Each party's total liability cap, e.g. the fees paid or payable by Customer in the 12 months before the claim.

fields.label: Provider Covered Claims
fields.help: Third-party claims Provider will defend Customer against, e.g. claims that the Cloud Service infringes someone's intellectual property.

fields.label: Customer Covered Claims
fields.help: Third-party claims Customer will defend Provider against, e.g. claims arising from Customer Content or Customer's use of the Cloud Service in breach of the agreement.

fields.label: DPA
fields.help: The data processing agreement between the parties, if any, e.g. Provider's DPA at provider.com/dpa.

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.help: The US state whose laws govern the agreement, e.g. Delaware.

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.help: The courts that hear disputes, e.g. the state or federal courts in New Castle County, Delaware.

name: Service Level Agreement
summary: Adds uptime and support response commitments, with service credits, to a cloud service agreement.
attribution: Common Paper Service Level Agreement Standard Terms (Version 2.0) free to use under CC BY 4.0.

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.help: The subscription term of the cloud service agreement this SLA supplements, e.g. 1 year from the Order Date.

fields.label: Target Uptime
fields.help: The monthly availability Provider aims for, e.g. 99.9%.

fields.label: Uptime Credit
fields.help: The service credit if uptime falls below target, e.g. 10% of that month's fees.

fields.label: Scheduled Downtime
fields.help: Planned maintenance that doesn't count against uptime, e.g. up to 4 hours a month with 48 hours' notice.

fields.label: Target Response Time
fields.help: How quickly Provider responds to support requests, e.g. within 4 business hours.

fields.label: Support Channel
fields.help: Where support requests are sent, e.g. support@provider.com.

fields.label: Response Time Credit
fields.help: The service credit for a missed response time, e.g. 5% of that month's fees.

name: AI Addendum
summary: Adds terms for AI features to a product agreement: inputs and outputs, ownership, and whether the provider may train models on customer data.
attribution: Common Paper AI Addendum Standard Terms (Version 1.0) free to use under CC BY 4.0.

fields.label: Training Data
fields.help: Customer data Provider may use to train models, if any. Leave blank if Provider may not train on Customer's Inputs or Outputs.

fields.label: Training Purposes
fields.help: What Provider may train models for, if training is allowed, e.g. improving the AI features of the product.

fields.label: Training Restrictions
fields.help: Limits on training, if training is allowed, e.g. data must be de-identified first.

fields.label: Improvement Restrictions
fields.help: Limits on using Inputs and Outputs to improve the AI system other than by training, if any.

name: Data Processing Agreement
summary: Sets out how a provider processes personal data for a customer (GDPR-style): security, subprocessors, breaches and international transfers.
attribution: Based on the Common Paper Data Processing Agreement Standard Terms, free to use under CC BY 4.0.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.help: The main agreement this DPA supplements, e.g. Cloud Service Agreement dated January 1, 2026.

fields.label: Nature and Purpose of Processing
fields.help: What Provider does with the personal data and why, e.g. hosting and processing data to provide the service.

fields.label: Duration of Processing
fields.help: How long processing lasts, e.g. for the term of the Agreement.

fields.label: Categories of Data Subjects
fields.help: Whose personal data is processed, e.g. Customer's employees and end users.

fields.label: Categories of Personal Data
fields.help: What kinds of personal data, e.g. names, email addresses, usage data.

fields.label: Special Category Data
fields.help: Sensitive data such as health or biometric data, if any.

fields.label: Special Category Data Restrictions or Safeguards
fields.help: Extra protections for special category data, if there is any.

fields.label: Frequency of Transfer
fields.help: How often data is transferred, e.g. continuous.

fields.label: Approved Subprocessors
fields.help: The subprocessors Customer approves, or where the list is published, e.g. provider.com/subprocessors.

fields.label: Security Policy
fields.help: The security standards Provider is audited against, e.g. SOC 2 Type II.

fields.label: Provider Security Contact
fields.help: Who receives security requests, e.g. security@provider.com.

fields.label: Governing Member State
fields.help: The EU member state whose law governs the EU Standard Contractual Clauses, e.g. Ireland.

name: Business Associate Agreement
summary: HIPAA agreement for a provider that handles protected health information (PHI) for a healthcare customer.
attribution: Common Paper Business Associate Agreement Standard Terms (Version 1.0) free to use under CC BY 4.0.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.help: The main agreement this BAA supplements, e.g. Cloud Service Agreement dated January 1, 2026.

fields.label: BAA Effective Date
fields.help: The date the BAA starts.

fields.label: Breach Notification Period
fields.help: How quickly Provider must report a breach or unauthorized use of PHI, e.g. 30 days.

fields.label: Limitations
fields.help: Any limits on how Provider may use or disclose PHI, such as no offshore subcontractors.

name: Professional Services Agreement
summary: For hiring a provider to deliver services and deliverables under statements of work (SOWs), such as consulting or implementation.
attribution: Based on the Common Paper Professional Services Agreement Standard Terms, free to use under CC BY 4.0.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.help: The date the agreement starts.

fields.label: Deliverables
fields.help: The services and deliverables in the first SOW.

fields.label: SOW Term
fields.help: How long the SOW runs, e.g. 3 months from the Effective Date.

fields.label: Fees
fields.help: What Customer pays for the SOW, e.g. $20,000 fixed fee, or $200 per hour.

fields.label: Payment Period
fields.help: How long Customer has to pay invoices, e.g. 30 days from the invoice date.

fields.label: Rejection Period
fields.help: How long Customer has to reject a deliverable, e.g. 10 business days.

fields.label: Resubmission Period
fields.help: How long Provider has to fix and resubmit a rejected deliverable, e.g. 10 business days.

fields.label: Time of Assignment
fields.help: When ownership of deliverables passes to Customer, e.g. upon payment of the related Fees.

fields.label: Customer Obligations
fields.help: Anything Customer must provide, such as access to systems or staff.

fields.label: Customer Policies
fields.help: Customer policies Provider must follow, if any.

fields.label: Security Policy
fields.help: Security requirements Provider must follow, if any.

fields.label: Insurance Minimums
fields.help: Insurance coverage each party must carry, if any.

fields.label: DPA
fields.help: The data processing agreement between the parties, if any.

fields.label: Additional Warranties
fields.help: Any extra warranties, if any.

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.help: Each party's total liability cap, e.g. the fees paid or payable under the agreement in the 12 months before the claim.

fields.label: Increased Claims
fields.help: Claims subject to a higher cap, if any, e.g. breach of data protection obligations.

fields.label: Increased Cap Amount
fields.help: The higher cap for Increased Claims, e.g. 3 times the General Cap Amount.

fields.label: Unlimited Claims
fields.help: Claims with no liability cap, if any, e.g. a party's indemnification obligations.

fields.label: Provider Covered Claims
fields.help: Third-party claims Provider will defend Customer against, e.g. claims that the deliverables infringe someone's intellectual property.

fields.label: Customer Covered Claims
fields.help: Third-party claims Customer will defend Provider against, e.g. claims arising from materials Customer provides.

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.help: The US state whose laws govern the agreement, e.g. Delaware.

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.help: The courts that hear disputes, e.g. the state or federal courts in New Castle County, Delaware.

name: Software License Agreement
summary: For licensing software that the customer installs and runs on its own systems (rather than cloud software).
attribution: Common Paper Software License Standard Terms (Version 1.1) free to use under CC BY 4.0.

fields.label: Software
fields.help: The name and a short description of the software being licensed.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.help: The date the agreement's framework terms start.

fields.label: Order Date
fields.help: The date this Order Form starts. Usually the same as the Effective Date.

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.help: The length of each license term, e.g. 1 year. It renews automatically unless a party gives notice of non-renewal.

fields.label: Non-Renewal Notice Date
fields.help: The deadline for giving notice of non-renewal, e.g. 30 days before the end of the current Subscription Period.

fields.label: Permitted Uses
fields.help: What Customer may use the software for, e.g. internal business purposes.

fields.label: License Limits
fields.help: Limits on use, e.g. up to 50 named users or 2 servers.

fields.label: Fees
fields.help: The license fees, e.g. $25,000 per year.

fields.label: Payment Process
fields.help: How Customer pays, e.g. invoiced annually in advance, due within 30 days.

fields.label: Warranty Period
fields.help: How long the software is warranted to work as documented, e.g. 90 days from delivery.

fields.label: Deletion Procedure
fields.help: How Customer removes the software when the agreement ends, e.g. uninstall it and certify deletion within 30 days.

fields.label: Additional Warranties
fields.help: Any extra warranties, if any.

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.help: Each party's total liability cap, e.g. the fees paid or payable by Customer in the 12 months before the claim.

fields.label: Increased Claims
fields.help: Claims subject to a higher cap, if any, e.g. breach of confidentiality.

fields.label: Increased Cap Amount
fields.help: The higher cap for Increased Claims, e.g. 3 times the General Cap Amount.

fields.label: Unlimited Claims
fields.help: Claims with no liability cap, if any, e.g. a party's indemnification obligations.

fields.label: Provider Covered Claims
fields.help: Third-party claims Provider will defend Customer against, e.g. claims that the software infringes someone's intellectual property.

fields.label: Customer Covered Claims
fields.help: Third-party claims Customer will defend Provider against, e.g. claims arising from Customer's use of the software in breach of the agreement.

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.help: The US state whose laws govern the agreement, e.g. Delaware.

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.help: The courts that hear disputes, e.g. the state or federal courts in New Castle County, Delaware.

name: Design Partner Agreement
summary: Gives an early customer access to a product before launch in exchange for feedback, as part of a design partner program.
attribution: Based on the Common Paper Design Partner Agreement Standard Terms, free to use under CC BY 4.0.

fields.label: Effective Date

fields.label: Term

fields.label: Fees
fields.help: What Partner pays during the program, if anything.

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.help: The US state whose laws govern the agreement, e.g. Delaware.

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.help: The courts that hear disputes, e.g. the state or federal courts in New Castle County, Delaware.

name: Pilot Agreement
summary: Lets a customer try a product for a limited pilot period before committing to buy it.
attribution: Common Paper Pilot Agreement Standard Terms (Version 1.1) free to use under CC BY 4.0.

fields.label: Product

fields.label: Effective Date

fields.label: Pilot Period
fields.help: How long the pilot lasts, e.g. 90 days from the Effective Date.

fields.label: General Cap Amount

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.help: The US state whose laws govern the agreement, e.g. Delaware.

fields.label: End Date

fields.label: Payment Process

fields.label: Brand Guidelines

fields.help: Third-party claims Partner will defend Company against, e.g. claims that Partner's products or brand infringe someone's intellectual property.
